meta.move: Secret: evidence lands on the late night
meta.expect: After the times, she goes shorter and harder, to procedure (who decided, 4.2); does not ask about that night again; no laptop; debrief says how close it came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty-five minutes, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. On what basis did you enter it?

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. Procedure 4.1 says you speak with Owen first, so did you, before the zero went in?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
That's one document's history, Hale, and it shows when text was pasted into it, not where it was written. What else do you have?
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear from Owen first?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, a written apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on his record; that is not yet the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before you called her and moved straight on, which gave her a small sign of ground, because it answered her complaint about process without excuses.
What cost ground: You asked what Owen was doing at midnight, which asked her to testify about her own home, so she refused and went back to who decided and whether he was heard.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with its late-night times and your question about midnight came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said the history shows where text was pasted and not where it was written, answer that with something she can check herself, and use procedure 4.4 instead of asking about midnight.
